skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental knowledge of economics in the context of national economy.
Analyze the development of trade in Vietnam across different periods and current challenges in the context of international trade integration.
Apply foundational knowledge of business management in the context of national economy.
Propose solutions for macroeconomic trade issues in Vietnam.
Implement effective organizational and management practices for trade operations in businesses.
Demonstrate teamwork, management, and leadership skills in international trade environments.
Show self-reliance and responsibility in independent work.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in decision-making and business activities.
